source: TradingView only: public chart feed for NSE:<SYMBOL>, TradingView's own daily Renko (box assignment ATR, length 14, source Close, wicks on; box size and rounding exactly as TradingView sets them); Hull Suite HMA 55 + MACD 12/26/9 on brick closes; gap from TradingView daily candles

rules.SELL: green->red flip AND Hull RED AND hist DARK GREEN->LIGHT GREEN or LIGHT RED->DARK RED
rules.BUY: red->green flip AND Hull GREEN AND hist DARK RED->LIGHT RED or LIGHT GREEN->DARK GREEN

exit_rule.text: Signal study: entry = marker price (close of the last brick of the setup's colour on the setup day); stop 3.0% and target 3.0% (1:1); outcome from TradingView daily bars after the setup day; stop counts first if both are hit the same day

strong_rule.text: Strong = setup-day open gapped >= 0.5% in the setup's direction vs the prior TradingView daily close AND only one Renko brick formed that day (the daily-candle Hull is not part of Strong; it is shown separately)
